rating.comments: The first student message is the task statement and is ignored. Student replies were 'no', 'can u propose positive impacts', 'and can u propose negative impacts', and 'are there any negativwe impacts'. None gives a reason or step, and none builds on earlier content. The request 'are there any negativwe impacts' asks about the content of the task (whether negative impacts exist), so question_asking is scored 1, though it is borderline. Effort is scored 2 because there are only fragmentary replies with no complete attempt, and the student never answered the AI's questions.
